ic_name: SD Memory Card (SD Simplified Physical Layer Specification)

registers.name: OCR
registers.access: Read (via ACMD41 R3 / CMD58 in SPI)
registers.description: Voltage windows + busy/ready bit + CCS (SDHC/SDXC) + S18A + UHS-II indicator.

registers.name: CID
registers.description: Factory-programmed (OTP). Fields: MID, OID, PNM, PRV, PSN, MDT, CRC7.

registers.name: CSD
registers.description: Card characteristics: CSD_STRUCTURE, TAAC, NSAC, TRAN_SPEED, CCC, READ_BL_LEN, C_SIZE / C_SIZE_MULT, WP, file format. v1.0 (SDSC) and v2.0 (SDHC/SDXC).

registers.name: RCA
registers.description: Dynamically assigned by the card during identification.

registers.name: SCR
registers.description: Reports physical spec version, security version, bus widths, SD Spec3/4/5/X.

registers.name: SSR
registers.description: Detailed status: DAT_BUS_WIDTH, SECURED_MODE, SPEED_CLASS, AU_SIZE, ERASE_SIZE, UHS_SPEED_GRADE, VIDEO_SPEED_CLASS, APP_PERF_CLASS, CMD_QUEUE_SUPPORT.

registers.name: CSR
registers.description: Error flags + CURRENT_STATE bits 12:9 + APP_CMD + READY_FOR_DATA.

base_address: Defined at SoC level; offsets given relative to module base.
notes: The SD card exposes 7 standard on-card registers, read/written by dedicated commands rather than by a memory-mapped offset. They are: OCR, CID, CSD, RCA, DSR, SCR, SSR (SD Status); plus the Card Status Register (CSR) returned within R1 responses.
